reviews.conclusion: Three short menu sequences and a narrow/obscured game capture appear while throwing eyes. Menus alone cover approximately 0.75-2.25 s; the obscured interval leaves the -2.9833 s deficit only partly accounted for. No suspicious splice is established.

A death/respawn in the stronghold precedes End entry. Settings are open at proxy 11.75-14 s, giving 2.25-2.75 s bounds compatible with the 2.683 s deficit. Death screen is recorded separately and not assumed to pause the GUI clock.

Portal travel into the stronghold is followed by settings at proxy 2.25-3.5 s, whose 1.25-1.75 s bounds contain the 1.617 s deficit. A later narrow/obscured render is separately recorded with unknown pause state, so full exact accounting remains unresolved.

Bastion trading contains two brief pause/settings sequences. Their combined duration is approximately 0.5-1.5 s, compatible with the -1.0167 s deficit. Long inventories and chest looting remain distinct from pause time.

coverage.interpretation: Evidence-span interpolation between events in resolved, nonambiguous segments; not proof of continuity throughout those spans or the whole video. Matching heart modes are inference alternatives, not observed heart states.
